requirement: Implement a Python module that contains a linked list class with insert, delete, search, and reverse methods. All methods must be covered by tests.

spec.name: Linked list
spec.description: A singly linked list with insert, delete, search and reverse.

acceptance_criteria.text: The linked list supports insert, delete, search and reverse

tasks.title: Linked list
acceptance_criteria: insert(value) appends value to the end of the list
delete(value) removes the first node holding value and returns True, or returns False if it is absent
search(value) returns True if value is in the list, otherwise False
reverse() reverses the list in place
